text: ミウとミオは　ふたご　なの　ポケモンも　いっしょに　やりたいの

structure.jp: ミウとミオは　ふたご　なの
ポケモンも　いっしょに　やりたいの
structure.en: we want to do it together with Pokémon too

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to'. やりたい = 'want to do it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end gives the feeling of explaining something. A bare の is the soft form used by women and children, and it becomes なの after a thing word. ふたご　なの = 'we're twins, you see'.
